Electives: exactly 10 ECTS from Group A (Computing: COMP50001, COMP50003, COMP50013, COMP50009, COMP50010) and 25 ECTS from Groups B and C (Mathematics), with at least 15 ECTS from Group B (the JMC core maths modules MATH50012, MATH50015 to MATH50019).
